approval.notes: P4-046 support dialogue; Mart Weaver is distinct from apprentice Mart and the event remains candidate-only.

deterministic_offline.notes: One authored choice records the Mart Weaver Blackheads candidate hook.

nodes.text: Do not confuse my name with the young apprentice at your forge. I am shielding a weaver who cannot pay the guild fine, and I need your word kept out of the ledger.

choices.text: The contact stays out of the ledger.

effects.summary: Mart Weaver shielded a forge contact from a guild fine.

nodes.text: Then the thread holds for another day. That is enough, if we remember who is carrying it.

source_notes.summary: P4-046 example dialogue for the P4-045 Mart Weaver candidate event; the surname is intentional.
